value_stream.name: Trade-In, Buy-Back & Certified Pre-Owned Product Resale

fields.Participants: Service Center (VS-12.1), Returns (VS-32), ESG (VS-25), Pricing (VS-01.2), Finance (VS-17.4)

Automation Opportunity: - Program-economics modeling; category-ROI analytics; ESG-impact quantification
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695: strategy ESG-aligned (VS-25/VS-73); economics modeled & approved (VS-36); scope refurbishable
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-25/VS-73 (ESG/circular), VS-01/VS-01.2 (merch/pricing), VS-17.4 (finance), W4578–W4582 (design)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Negative-margin risk**: Refurbishment cost exceeds resale value; mitigated by unit-economics modeling (W4582)
- **Scope-overreach risk**: Taking back un-refurbishable items; mitigated by category/condition eligibility (W4578)

steps.activity: Merchandising/Circular Lead set the trade-in strategy & scope (which categories: power tools, appliances, equipment; trade-in vs buy-back; geographic/channel rollout), aligned to ESG (VS-25/VS-73)
Finance/Merchandising build the program economics (trade-in-driven new-purchase lift, refurbishment cost, resale margin, circular impact), and define success metrics vs do-nothing
Merchandising/ESG obtain approval, align to brand positioning (sustainability/affordability), and cascade to design (W4578–W4581)

Automation Opportunity: - Eligibility-check tool; channel-journey app; safety-exclusion validation
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695 (eligibility excludes unsafe/DG/recalled (VS-89/VS-114/VS-31); channels clear; consumer-protection-compliant (VS-22))
Cross-references: - links to VS-01 (merch), VS-12.1 (service center), VS-07 (stores), VS-32 (returns), VS-31 (quality), VS-06 (logistics), VS-89/VS-114 (safety), W4577 (strategy), W4585 (take-back)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unsafe-product risk**: Taking back unsafe/recalled/DG items; mitigated by safety exclusions (VS-89/VS-114/VS-31)
- **Channel-confusion risk**: Customer unsure how/where to trade in; mitigated by clear channel/journey
System Touchpoints: - Merchandising (VS-01); service center (VS-12.1); stores (VS-07); returns (VS-32); quality (VS-31); logistics (VS-06); compliance (VS-22)

steps.activity: Merchandising/Service Center set product eligibility (brands/models accepted, age/condition floor, safety/DG exclusions — no trade-in of DG/chemicals/recalled VS-89), per W4577 scope
Merchandising/Stores set take-back channels (in-store counter, service center VS-12.1, ecommerce mail-in), the customer journey, and any logistics for mail-in (VS-06)
Compliance/Legal ensure take-back is consumer-protection-compliant (clear terms, no obligation, RA 7394), and aligned to returns (VS-32) and quality (VS-31)

Automation Opportunity: - Valuation-engine app; objective-grading checklist; outcome-feedback tuning
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695 (valuation = resale-value-minus-refurb-cost (W4582); grading objective/consistent; tuned on outcomes (W4599))
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-12.1 (service center), VS-07 (stores), VS-28 (data), W4582 (unit economics), W4584 (systems), W4599 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-valuation risk**: Trade-in value > recoverable resale value → loss; mitigated by valuation-minus-refurb-cost engine & tuning
- **Grading-inconsistency risk**: Subjective grading across stores; mitigated by objective criteria & training
System Touchpoints: - Pricing (VS-01.2); service center (VS-12.1); stores (VS-07); data (VS-28); finance (VS-17.4); valuation system (W4584)
Time Estimate: - Per inquiry ~10–20 min grading; engine build weeks

steps.activity: Pricing/Service Center build the condition-grading model (e.g., A/B/C/for-parts) with objective criteria (function, cosmetic, age, battery/condition), and the valuation engine (grade × model × resale-value-minus-refurb cost)
Stores/Service Center apply the grading at counter (inspect, grade, system-generated valuation), presenting the trade-in value to the customer
Pricing/Data tune the valuation on resale/refurbishment outcomes (W4599), avoiding over/under-valuation, and refresh for model/age depreciation

Automation Opportunity: - POS trade-in-credit workflow; valuation-linked credit issuance; trade-in-basket analytics
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695 (credit per system valuation (W4579); SoD (issue ≠ approve); VAT-correct (VS-79); basket captured (W4599))
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-54 (gift card), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-01.2/VS-58 (pricing/promo), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-17/VS-79 (finance/tax), W4579 (valuation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit-fraud risk**: Fabricated/inflated trade-in credits (VS-125); mitigated by SoD & valuation-system control
- **Tax-treatment risk**: Mis-accounted trade-in VAT; mitigated by clear tax rule (VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - POS (VS-08); gift card (VS-54); loyalty (VS-13); pricing/promo (VS-01.2/VS-58); revenue assurance (VS-118); finance/tax (VS-17/VS-79)

steps.activity: Stores/POS issue the trade-in credit (store credit/gift-card VS-54, or loyalty points VS-13, or cash buy-back) at the accepted valuation (W4579), linked to the new-purchase basket
POS/Pricing apply the credit to the new purchase (trade-in-toward-new), with price/loyalty integrity (VS-118/VS-58), and capture the trade-in-driven basket for analytics (W4599)
Finance/Tax account the trade-in (credit issuance, trade-in inventory acquisition at valuation, VAT treatment VS-79), per VS-17

fields.Volume: Certified pre-owned pricing across resaleable items

Automation Opportunity: - Cost-based pricing automation; channel syndication; pricing-integrity monitoring (VS-118)
Controls: - CTL-82 (ensure trade-in device integrity & data wipe.)
- CTL-695: price ≥ acquisition+refurb+margin (W4582); clearly labeled certified-pre-owned (not new) (VS-118/VS-22); integrity monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-14 (marketing), VS-10/VS-65 (channels), VS-118 (revenue assurance), VS-25/VS-73 (ESG), W4580 (acquisition), W4582 (refurb cost), W4583 (warranty)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misrepresentation risk**: Pre-owned sold/marked as new → consumer-protection/fraud (RA 7394/VS-118); mitigated by clear certified-pre-owned labeling
- **Margin-erosion risk**: Price set below cost; mitigated by cost-based pricing floor
System Touchpoints: - Pricing (VS-01.2); finance (VS-17.4); marketing (VS-14); ecommerce/marketplace (VS-10/VS-65); loyalty (VS-13); revenue assurance (VS-118); ESG (VS-25)

steps.activity: Pricing/Finance set the certified pre-owned price (cost = acquisition W4580 + refurb W4582 + margin), positioned below new-SRP but above acquisition+refurb, per category/grade
Merchandising/Marketing position the certified pre-owned offer (grade, warranty W4583, sustainability story VS-25/VS-73, price-vs-new) and syndicate to channels (VS-10/VS-65/VS-13)
Revenue Assurance/Pricing monitor pre-owned pricing integrity (no misrepresentation as new, correct grade/price, no leakage VS-118) and adjust

fields.Volume: Refurbishment cost/yield model across eligible categories

Automation Opportunity: - Refurb-cost/yield analytics; unit-economics dashboards; profitability-driven eligibility tuning
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695: refurb cost & yield modeled per category/grade; unit economics positive (or exited); valuation/pricing cost-based
Cross-references: - links to VS-12.1 (service center), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-28 (data), VS-01.2 (pricing), VS-73 (circular), W4578 (eligibility), W4579 (valuation), W4581 (pricing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hidden-refurb-cost risk**: Underestimated parts/labor → margin loss; mitigated by detailed cost model & tracking
- **Low-yield risk**: Few items reach certified → program uneconomic; mitigated by yield modeling & eligibility tuning
System Touchpoints: - Service center (VS-12.1); finance (VS-17.4); data (VS-28); pricing (VS-01.2); quality (VS-31); circular (VS-73)

steps.activity: Service Center/Finance build the refurbishment cost model (labor, parts, testing, certification, by model/category/grade) and the yield model (% that reach certified vs for-parts/recycle VS-73)
Finance/Merchandising compute unit economics (acquisition W4580 + refurb W4582 vs resale W4581) per category/grade, identifying profitable vs unprofitable flows
Merchandising/Service Center tune eligibility (W4578)/valuation (W4579) on unit economics, exiting unprofitable flows and scaling profitable ones

Automation Opportunity: - Warranty-terms generation; claim/reserve management; liability-exposure analytics
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695 (certified-pre-owned warranty clearly scoped (distinct from new VS-53); safety-tested (W4589); disclosed (RA 7394); liability insured (VS-26))
Cross-references: - links to VS-53 (warranty), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-31/VS-89/VS-24 (quality/safety), VS-26 (insurance), VS-21.2 (risk), W4589 (certification)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Safety-liability risk**: Refurbished item fails safely → injury/liability (VS-26/VS-100); mitigated by safety testing (W4589) & insurance
- **Misrepresentation risk**: Pre-owned represented as warrantied-as-new; mitigated by clear warranty terms & disclosure
System Touchpoints: - Warranty (VS-53); legal (VS-100.3); compliance (VS-22); quality/safety (VS-31/VS-89/VS-24); insurance (VS-26); risk (VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Warranty/Merchandising set the certified-pre-owned warranty terms (period, coverage, exclusions, grade-differentiated), distinct from new-product warranty (VS-53)
Legal/Compliance set consumer-protection terms (clear "certified pre-owned" disclosure, no misrepresentation, RA 7394 return policy, liability for safety) and product-safety (VS-89/VS-24)

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Warranty/Insurance manage warranty-liability & claims (reserve, claim handling VS-53, product-liability insurance VS-26) and report exposure (VS-21.2)

workflows.name: Systems, Item-Coding & Inventory Setup for Pre-Owned

Automation Opportunity: - Unique-item/serial tracking; distinct pre-owned labeling (VS-151); distinct GL accounting
Controls: - CTL-695 (ensure controlled execution — Trade-In/Buy-Back Program Design, Valuation & Pricing (PA-155.1).)
- CTL-695 (pre-owned distinct SKU/serial & labeled (not conflated with new VS-118); inventory separated (VS-05); accounted distinctly (VS-17))
Cross-references: - links to VS-27/VS-113 (IT/EA), VS-29 (master data), VS-05 (inventory), VS-151 (auto-ID/labeling), VS-17 (finance), W4581 (pricing), W4593 (resale)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Item-conflation risk**: Pre-owned commingled with new stock/labels → misrepresentation (VS-118); mitigated by distinct SKU/serial & labeling
- **Accounting-error risk**: Pre-owned COGS mis-accounted; mitigated by distinct item-coding/accounting (VS-17)
System Touchpoints: - IT/EA (VS-27/VS-113); master data (VS-29); inventory (VS-05); auto-ID/labeling (VS-151); finance/GL (VS-17)

steps.activity: IT/EA/Master Data set up item-coding for pre-owned (distinct SKU/serial for each certified unit, grade, acquisition cost, refurb cost — unique-item tracking vs standard SKU), per VS-29/VS-113
Inventory/Auto-ID manage pre-owned inventory (serial-tracked, condition/grade, separate stock from new VS-05, Auto-ID/labeling VS-151 — "certified pre-owned" label)
Finance/IT account pre-owned inventory (acquisition cost as inventory, refurb cost capitalization, resale COGS — distinct from new-product accounting VS-17)
